description: a primeval goddess of the hunt, a woman with light tan skin, long light brown hair in braids hanging straight down her back at rest, not flying, eyes glowing amber, the head of a giant white wolf worn as a hood with huge curved golden-brown aurochs horns rising from it, the white wolf pelt hanging down her back as a long fur mantle, a deep crimson bodice, a necklace of great fangs, brown leather belts, olive brown trousers, ivory greaves and brown boots, a strong young woman's face in clean profile with one eye, no bow, no knife, no spirit wolves and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the tips of the horns to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same character seen from the side: face, braids, wolf hood with the horns, fur mantle, clothes, colours and drawing style; not the sitting pose and not the hands on the reins: she stands and walks
the character's look in detail: face, braids, wolf hood with the horns, fur mantle, clothes and colours; the hands empty, without the bow, the knife and the spirit wolves
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
